validation_only_amendment.only_change: Reject nonintegral image_hw before map(int); integer canvas computation unchanged

logic_review.initial_geometry: Expected-outline and self/truncation from the original cuboid pose are conditional hypotheses, not direct observed 3D visibility.
logic_review.strong_material_boundary: At unchanged raw q: p>=.65 plus two actual incident class-agnostic mask transition lines, max12px independent intersection, conditional covariance validation when present. It identifies local image support; requestedphysicalcorner ownership is unverified.
logic_review.visible_interior: Positive local RGB material estimate remains distinct from coordinate accuracy and boundary count.
logic_review.negative_RGB: UNKNOWN_OR_OCCLUSION; background, holes, virtual/rounded corner and wrong detector query remain competing explanations.
logic_review.OTHER_OBJECT_suspect: Requires separately point-bound independently observed different-instance region; overrides even highRGB material support and vetoes strong count.
logic_review.OTHER_OBJECT_confirmed: Requires independent source-verifiable physical requestedpoint depth/order on same ray with uncertainty margin; initialprojecteddepth is explicitly insufficient.
logic_review.producer_validation: Helper validates structured assertions/query/native binding and numericdepth order. It does not verify underlying source facts or sensor/instance outputs; source_facts_verified_by_this_helper remainsfalse.

deployment_limits: FULLCAL46 visibility head results are in-sample; a numerical p is not a semantic guarantee.
Geometric self/truncation can be wrong when the initial family/pose is wrong; fixedflags preserve provenance rather than certifylabels.
Two of90 image-strong points have humanSELF labels with initialHfalse. Neither material nor observedoutline proves requested3Dcorner visibility.
Class-agnostic mask quality/support/gaps provide no independent other-instance identity or foreground ordering.
A future external-producer integration must verify and retain actual source evidence; arbitrary supplied booleans/source strings are not certified by the helper.
Line resampling covariance omits semantic/corner-model bias and does not calibrate keypoint accuracy; priorCAL95ellipse coverage31.8percent.
Strong5/4/3counts are operational support, not mathematical pose uniqueness. Separate rank/spread/conditioning/trust checks and underconstrained fallback are required.
Projected completion coordinates must remain outputs and never become fit measurements or count supplements.
